QuestInfo.name: Hero of the Story
QuestInfo.0: #b#p203##k in #b#m10001000##k seems to have something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Took #p205#’s advice and visited #p203# to ask about #bAlloy#k, the author of #b#t4160001##k. She said her grandfather’s latest letter was about #bWing, the Fairy of #m10002000##k, and suggested I go see #p309#.
QuestInfo.2: #p309# recalls #bAlloy#k as the human who obtained #r#o700004#’s#k shell to extend his own lifespan. Let’s ask a few more questions.

0.0: I’m busy with preparing for the festival, so please make it quick. What? You’re talking about great-grandfather Alloy? Did he get himself into trouble? Phew... that’s a relief. It’s good to know he is healthy and all, but he sometimes gets into trouble while traveling around the sea.
0.1: I don’t know where he is now, because he moves around too much looking for adventures. However, I do have a letter sent from him to me recently. I can show you the letter to you if you’d like.

yes.0: It seems he is in #b#m10002000##k now. Apparently, he boasted in his letter that he became friends with #b#p309##k. Therefore, he has to be in #m10002000# with #p309#. But then again, he does move around a lot, so he may have left Ellinia already.

no.0: Don’t blame you if you don’t what to know. Could you please move over so I can continue preparing for the festival?

1.0: What... are you? Aren't you human? What’s your business here? What? You’re asking about Alloy?!

yes.0: How can I NOT know him?! Every fairy in #m10002000# knows him! Don’t matter if it’s good or bad! He’s such a disgusting human! He has a loud voice, too talkative, and he puts his nose into everything he can bug into!
yes.1: Hmm... but he wasn’t a bad person at all. Quite funny, in a... strange, sort of way. Underneath the fuss, he was intelligent and wise also. I’ve heard he got #r#o700004#’s#k Shell. Maybe the shell that made him like that? Still, he was a fair guy for a human being.
yes.2: Huh? You don’t know what #o700004#'s Shell is? It’s the shell of the longest-living snail in Maple World. It’s special for its rainbow color. What? You want to see #o700004# itself? Well... but what for?

npc.0: You haven’t met #b#p309##k yet, haven’t you? You don’t have to if you don’t want to.
